## Data source

The OpenAlex harvester fetches data from the [OpenAlex API](https://api.openalex.org/works).

## Supported identifiers

- orcid

## Data conversion

OpenAlex document types are mapped to RDF classes following the table provided in the
[CRISalid data model documentation](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1378320388).
